content.text:
**Root cause:** `main.ts.tmpl` had a whole "split-pane" feature block (resize handle, orientation toggle, pane swap, fullscreen buttons) wiring up elements like `#split-pane`, `#split-handle`, `#toggle-orientation`, etc. via non-null-asserted `querySelector` calls. But `app.html`/`app.css` had already been simplified to a fixed editor-on-top/preview-below layout (there's an uncommitted changeset describing exactly this), so those elements no longer exist — `document.querySelector(...)!` returned `null`, and calling `.addEventListener` on it threw at load time (the minified `Tw` in the console trace).

**Fix:** removed the dead split-pane JS block from [main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L356), since the HTML/CSS intentionally dropped that UI already.

Regenerated `packages/scaffold/generated/scaffolds.ts` (`vp run generate`) and rebuilt the docs bundle (`node scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts`) — the new bundle no longer references the removed selectors. Reload `/guide/canvas-rce` to confirm the error is gone.
